incident: 2026-10-13, GA03/GA14/GA15 of the general-agent review: keyword rules routed ordinary work (a sales spreadsheet, 'what is peer review', a pull request, a message-queue comparison) into medical pipelines, before the model was asked, over its clean none, or when it was unavailable.
question: Does the model alone — with the request, the catalog and the ids the request names — send ordinary work to the conversation line and a commission to its own specialist? Every sample of every case must agree with `expect`.
expect: "none": no specialist; a specialist id; or a list of the answers that are all right. The statements are the 2026-10-12 self-descriptions (`statement-*`) and the commissions that must keep their specialist (`commission-*`); a list marks a request whose specialist cannot run without an input it does not supply.
